instruction: Search arXiv for papers about 'Mistral' language models published in September 2023, and add at least one such paper to the spreadsheet with its title, arXiv link, and publication date.

parameters.window_name: New Large Language Models.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc

metadata.explanation: Task requires searching for and adding at least one Mistral-related paper from September 2023 to the spreadsheet with title, arXiv link, and publication date. The evaluator retrieves all paper entries (title from column A, arXiv link from column B, publication date from column C) and checks if any row contains: (1) 'Mistral' in the title, (2) a valid arXiv link, and (3) publication date in September 2023. Returns 1.0 if all three requirements are met in at least one row, 0.0 otherwise.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies all three requirements from instruction (title with 'Mistral', arXiv link, publication date in September 2023)
Correct getter logic: get_xlsx_all_titles__f7a262b5 properly extracts all three required columns (A: title, B: arXiv link, C: publication date) from spreadsheet

Comprehensive metric verification: check_keyword_exists__f7a262b5 checks all three criteria for each paper entry - keyword in title (lines 30-32), valid arXiv link (lines 34-45), and matching publication date (lines 47-63)
Robust date matching: Metric handles multiple date format patterns (September/Sep/09/2023-09) to flexibly verify September 2023 publication
Valid arXiv link detection: Metric properly checks for various arXiv link formats (arxiv.org URLs, arXiv: prefix, or arXiv ID pattern)
Correct evaluation logic: Returns 1.0 only when at least one row contains ALL three requirements together, 0.0 otherwise
Appropriate postconfig: Saves the file before evaluation to ensure state freshness
